name: Grange Farm
stayType: Clifftop farm campsite with cottages and statics
accommodation: Tent, caravan and motorhome pitches (some with hook-up), camping pods, static caravans and converted barn cottages; open 1 April to 31 October
suitableFor: Families, campers and anyone wanting a range of options from pitches to cottages
parking: Off-road parking, parking next to pitches (Visit Isle of Wight listing)
dogs: Welcome on a lead (Visit Isle of Wight listing)
beachAccess: Direct access to Brighstone beach (Visit Isle of Wight listing)
confirmedFeatures: Shop, shower and toilet blocks, launderette, play area, cycle hire, farm animals, electric hook-ups
overview: Grange Farm is a family campsite on the clifftop at Brighstone Bay, a few miles along the Military Road from Compton Bay. Guests can choose from grass and hard-standing pitches, pods, static caravans and barn cottages, and there is a shop, a launderette and direct access down to Brighstone beach.
surfTripFit: Clifftop on the same south-west-facing stretch of coast, with its own beach access and a short drive to Compton.
